summary: Small sealed trailhead car park in forest off Ford Road, no homes near.
reasons: Sealed car park with its own entrance

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by bushland. The only mapped building is a non-dwelling about 29 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed entrance off Ford Road; several marked bays with room for a van at the top end.
drivers.traffic: Moderate traffic on Ford Road, but the car park is set back from the lane.
drivers.convention: Mapped access yes, no fee; 6 to 8 cars parked, likely walkers using the trails.

flags: Steep: about 5.9% mean in DEM, 11.8% max
Walkers and trail users may come and go early
Mapped gates 21 m and 48 m away, not on the only access
sun_shade: Mixed; a tree shades the north end, the rest is open to the sky.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park closes at night

best_section.where: Sealed car park just off Ford Road, at the ring
